text: Risk management is the process of identifying possible problems before they happen and taking steps to reduce their impact. The first step is to identify risks, which means looking carefully at what could go wrong in a project or business. Once risks are known, mitigation strategies can be used to lower the chance of problems or limit the damage they cause. It is also wise to prepare contingency plans, which are backup plans in case something fails. Finally, monitoring is essential because risks can change over time. By checking regularly, people can react quickly and keep situations under control.
